calls.thesis: First tracked MELI call. Added to his position after the 12.4% post-earnings drop to near 52-week lows (~$1,500, ~$76bn market cap): revenue +45% (+41% FX-neutral), TPV +53%, GMV +38%, Brazil accelerating +50%, fintech 93m MAU +29%, credit book +62%, ads +51% and taking share; margins are being deliberately sacrificed to compound, and he estimates the business already earns ~$6bn of underlying profit (~13x). A 5-10-20 year hold; short-term volatility irrelevant.
calls.price_at_call: ~$1,500 (down 12.4% on the day, near 52-week lows; ~$76bn market cap)
calls.base_case: Growth stays 20%+ and margins expand once investment slows; profits explode as the credit/advertising flywheel matures.
calls.bull_case: In 5 years revenue is multiples higher and the stock is far above $1,500 as LatAm digitisation compounds.
calls.bear_case: Margins never expand, Mexico deceleration spreads, or 90+ day NPLs (uptrending ~19.3%) deteriorate into real credit losses.
